visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a black backwards baseball cap and a black t-shirt stands in a kitchen studio. He holds a white plate with fried potato wedges and points his finger at the camera. A Golden Retriever dog is visible in the bottom right, looking upwards at the man. The background features stainless steel sinks, a microwave, and framed posters on a white wall. (2) Close-up shot of a hand wearing a white glove sprinkling salt into a pot of boiling water containing several cut potato wedges. Steam rises from the pot. (3) Extreme close-up of two boiled potato wedges resting on a stainless steel wire cooling rack. The texture of the potato is soft and slightly broken at the edges. (4) The man returns to the frame, gesturing with his hands while explaining. He stands in the same studio environment with shelves of cooking ingredients behind him. (5) A medium-long shot shows many potato wedges spread out on a wire rack placed in front of a rotating electric floor fan on a black counter. (6) The man is shown opening a stainless steel commercial refrigerator door and sliding in a tray of prepared potato wedges. (7) Close-up of potato wedges deep-frying in a cast-iron pot filled with bubbling hot oil. (8) A hand using a metal mesh strainer scoops golden-brown fried potatoes out of the oil and places them onto a plate lined with white paper towels. (9) A finished plate of crispy potato wedges and a small piece of fried fish decorated with greens is shown on a wooden board. (10) The man holds a single golden-brown potato wedge, takes a bite, and smiles. The dog appears in the frame again, looking very alert and interested. (11) A rapid montage of the man holding the wedge and moving it toward the camera lens repeatedly in a looping motion.

A rhythmic electronic BGM with a strong, driving beat plays in the background. The speech rate is energetic. (2) A transition whoosh SFX occurs as the scene changes. The man continues speaking about the cooking process. (3) The sound of boiling water and bubbling liquid is clearly audible under the narration, accompanied by the steady BGM. (4) A metallic clinking sound occurs as kitchen tools are used. The BGM remains consistent in volume and tempo. (5) An electric fan hum is briefly audible. The man's voice remains the dominant signal. (6) A sharp sizzle sound of oil is introduced, peaking in intensity as the potatoes are fried. (7) A loud, crisp crunching sound is heard as the man bites into the food, emphasized by a slight dip in the BGM volume. (8) A dog's bark interrupts the narration briefly, indicating high excitement. (9) The audio concludes with a fast-paced vocal loop '按 按 按 按' (Press, press, press, press) synced with a rapid BGM build-up and a final impact SFX.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To provide a highly energetic and clear tutorial on how to achieve the perfect crunchy texture for homemade potato wedges by using specific techniques like air-drying and refrigerating. The video uses fast-paced editing and auditory cues to maintain high viewer engagement.
